check:pose-allocations: 2000 warm-up frames of the 1024-player threaded tick on the planet-surface scene, the spawn the render witness uses, at about 4 ms a frame. On the flat scene the bodies fall off the ground box under planet gravity and never sleep, so each frame costs about 20 ms and the same warm-up takes 88 s. With 300 or 700 warm-up frames the sampler still sees one-off function-level allocations (10128 B and 1224 B) from V8 tier-up, so the warm-up cannot be shortened without a false failure. Counted frames are sampled per allocation.
check:engine-state-hash-1024: Five isolated 1024-tier runs of 120 ticks (fixed, and 2, 4, 7, 8 workers). They now run at the same time; before, they ran one after another and the 4-worker run was done twice (29 s).
check:gc-witness: 20000 measured ticks and 20000 control ticks under a GC observer. The count is the claim, so the ticks stay.
check:elevation-ab: Runs spoint A/B elevation script at the fixture N and compares its output line for line.
check:scenario-marble-bowl: 512 marbles for 600 ticks, twice, on four tiers. Containment, settling and bit-for-bit agreement are the claims here. The per-tick wall-time claim (no tick over 25 ms or 16.7 ms) moved to the Kaggle run (scripts/kaggle/marble.mjs, recorded at the end of docs/CHECK_TIMES.md), because under host load another session pushed 8 ticks over 25 ms here and the check failed, and it passed alone.
check:height-cpu: Evaluates every spoint height fixture sample to 1e-12.
check:heightmap-cli: Runs the heightmap CLI once per fixture case.
check:sphere-population: Places the full sphere population and checks every member.
check:engine-threads: Runs the threaded scenario at several worker counts.
check:mapspinner-atmosphere: Integrates the atmosphere tables against spoint values.
check:snapshots: Encodes and decodes the delta history at full depth.
check:thread-sampler: Samples real threads over a timed window.
build:kernel: Compiles the kernel with jz. It is skipped when src/kernel and the jz package are unchanged.
check:engine-job-wait: Five runs of 300 ticks of 1200 bodies in 100 piles: fixed, and 2 and 4 workers twice each.
check:vegetation-allocations: 6000 warm-up frames before the sampled window; at 2000 the compile of the gate function landed inside the window.
check:vegetation-generate-cost: Times 512 patches of 1024 instances and 128 patches of 8439.
check:scenario-determinism: 64 child runs: eight scenarios on the fixed build and the threaded build at 2 and 4 workers, for two build pairs.
check:scenario-allocations: 30000 warm-up ticks per loop, one loop per process.
check:scenario-lockstep-rts: Six peers per tier on four tiers.
check:scenario-deathrun: Six runs per tier on four tiers.
check:scenario-boss-fight: Six runs per tier on four tiers.
check:engine-tiers: The settle row spawns 10240 bodies at the scene spacing (1.2 m, above the 1.0 m diameter) and steps 360 ticks, so the counted window covers the fall and the sleep. At 0.6 m spacing the bodies overlapped and the same row took 62 s, and that overlap case is no longer covered by this gate.
check:engine-host-witness: Compiles the native witness when a source under engine/src or engine/test changed; 0.4 s otherwise.
check:scenario-character-terrain: Four tiers of slope, step and descent runs with their controls.
check:planet-witness-scene: Builds the witness scene three times on the 1024-tier engine and runs one camera lap.
check:alloc-audit: Sixteen rows of 50,000 calls each under a 1 MiB semi-space.
check:scenario-combat-bots: Two runs on four tiers, with the duel and its wall and ridge controls.
check:scenario-planet-landing: Two runs of 480 ticks on four tiers.
